# position ordinal

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:positionOrdinal`](gmeow-positionOrdinal.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/positionOrdinal>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The ordinal coordinate of this position within its frame — a chapter index, scene number, or fabula sequence number. Functional within one position; ordering semantics belong to the frame, and comparisons to the solver layer ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:NarrativePosition`](../classes/gmeow-NarrativePosition.md) -> [`xsd:integer`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:positionOrdinal`](gmeow-positionOrdinal.md) from [`gmeow:NarrativePosition`](../classes/gmeow-NarrativePosition.md) to [`xsd:integer`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Flashback

- **Source:** [`slices/extensions/narrative/examples/flashback.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/extensions/narrative/examples/flashback.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-extensions-narrative-examples-flashback)#example-slices-extensions-narrative-examples-flashback

```turtle
# Told late: chapter 5 (discourse ordinal 5).
ex:posTold a gmeow:NarrativePosition ;
    gmeow:positionFrame   ex:discourseFrame ;
    gmeow:positionOrdinal "5"^^xsd:integer ;
    gmeow:positionLabel   "Chapter 5 (flashback)" .

# Happened first: story ordinal 0.
ex:posHappened a gmeow:NarrativePosition ;
    gmeow:positionFrame   ex:storyFrame ;
    gmeow:positionOrdinal "0"^^xsd:integer ;
    gmeow:positionLabel   "Year 0 — the beginning of the saga" .
```
